meta.promptText: Which face wash should I buy for oily skin in India under ₹500?

response.text:
For oily, acne-prone, or combination skin in India, the best face washes under ₹500 rely on active ingredients like **Salicylic Acid (BHA)**, **Glycolic Acid**, or **Niacinamide** to clear out sebum without completely stripping your skin barrier.

The top options available in India well within your budget include:

### 1. Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid + LHA Face Cleanser

* **Price:** ~₹299[medium.com](https://medium.com/@dhruvsharma2359/best-face-wash-for-oily-skin-in-india-2026-dermatologist-backed-guide-f063b3d293dc#:~:text=They%20were%20selected%20based%20on%20ingredient%20quality%2C,a%20strong%20reputation%20for%20transparent%20ingredient%20formulations.)
* **Key Ingredients:** 2% Salicylic Acid, LHA, Zinc[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/skin/cleansers/face-wash/c/8379#:~:text=%28217.9K%29%20Simple.%20Refreshing%20Facial%20Wash%2C%20100%25%20Soap-Free,Acne.%202%20Sizes.%20Oily%20Skin.%20%E2%82%B9299%E2%82%B926910%25%20Off.)
* **Why it’s great:** This is a cult favorite for very oily and acne-prone skin.[medium.com](https://medium.com/@dhruvsharma2359/best-face-wash-for-oily-skin-in-india-2026-dermatologist-backed-guide-f063b3d293dc#:~:text=They%20were%20selected%20based%20on%20ingredient%20quality%2C,a%20strong%20reputation%20for%20transparent%20ingredient%20formulations.) It is fragrance-free, sulfate-free, and contains Zinc which helps regulate sebum production.[medium.com](https://medium.com/@dhruvsharma2359/best-face-wash-for-oily-skin-in-india-2026-dermatologist-backed-guide-f063b3d293dc#:~:text=299%20to%20Rs.%20349%20Available%20At%3A%20Nykaa%2C,straightforward%2C%20no-nonsense%20options%20in%20the%20Indian%20market.) LHA provides gentle exfoliation on the surface while Salicylic Acid dives deep into pores to clear out blackheads and whiteheads.

### 2. Plum Green Tea Pore Cleansing Face Wash

* **Price:** ~₹345[nourishmantra.in](https://nourishmantra.in/blogs/news/best-cleanser-for-face-in-india#:~:text=Why%20it's%20loved%3A%20Soothing%20formula%20with%20green,Face%20Shop%20Rice%20Water%20Bright%20Foaming%20Cleanser.)
* **Key Ingredients:** Green Tea Extracts, Glycolic Acid[medium.com](https://medium.com/@dhruvsharma2359/best-face-wash-for-oily-skin-in-india-2026-dermatologist-backed-guide-f063b3d293dc#:~:text=*%202.%20Plum%20Green%20Tea%20Pore%20Cleansing,acid%20helps%20maintain%20clear%20skin%20without%20over-drying.)
* **Why it’s great:** If you want a gentle, refreshing cleanse with natural components, this is a top pick.[medium.com](https://medium.com/@dhruvsharma2359/best-face-wash-for-oily-skin-in-india-2026-dermatologist-backed-guide-f063b3d293dc#:~:text=*%202.%20Plum%20Green%20Tea%20Pore%20Cleansing,acid%20helps%20maintain%20clear%20skin%20without%20over-drying.) The glycolic acid mildly exfoliates dead skin cells, while green tea helps control excess oil and calms active acne flare-ups.[medium.com](https://medium.com/@dhruvsharma2359/best-face-wash-for-oily-skin-in-india-2026-dermatologist-backed-guide-f063b3d293dc#:~:text=*%202.%20Plum%20Green%20Tea%20Pore%20Cleansing,acid%20helps%20maintain%20clear%20skin%20without%20over-drying.) It leaves the skin feeling clean without feeling tight.

### 3. Deconstruct Salicylic Acid & Niacinamide Oil Control Face Wash

* **Price:** ~₹299[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/skin/cleansers/face-wash/c/8379#:~:text=All%20Skin%20Type.%20%E2%82%B9449%E2%82%B938215%25%20Off.%20Flash%20Sale,Price%20dropped%20by%20%E2%82%B938.%204.5.%20%28217.9K%29%20Simple.)
* **Key Ingredients:** 2% Salicylic Acid, 1.5% Niacinamide[blog.flash.co](https://blog.flash.co/face-wash/top-10-face-washes-with-salicylic-acid/#:~:text=Deconstruct%20Salicylic%20Acid%20Oil%20Control%20Facewash%20*,platforms%20including%20Nykaa%2C%20Amazon%2C%20Flipkart%2C%20and%20Purplle.)
* **Why it’s great:** This formulation hits two targets at once: salicylic acid tackles deep-seated oil and clogged pores, while niacinamide works to fade acne marks, soothe redness, and balance overall oil production.[blog.flash.co](https://blog.flash.co/face-wash/top-10-face-washes-with-salicylic-acid/#:~:text=Chemist%20At%20Play%20Oil%20%26%20Acne%20Control,knowing%20exact%20concentrations.%2094%2F100.%20%E2%82%B9249.%20%E2%86%93%209.)

### 4. Foxtale Oil & Acne Control Face Wash

* **Price:** ~₹329[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/skin/cleansers/face-wash/c/8379#:~:text=%2837.3K%29%20The%20Derma%20Co.%20Sali-Cinamide%20Anti-Acne%20Face,Skin.%20%E2%82%B9329%E2%82%B928314%25%20Off.%204.%20%281.8K%29%20Ghar%20Soaps.)
* **Key Ingredients:** 2% Salicylic Acid, Cica[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/skin/cleansers/face-wash/c/8379#:~:text=%2837.3K%29%20The%20Derma%20Co.%20Sali-Cinamide%20Anti-Acne%20Face,Skin.%20%E2%82%B9329%E2%82%B928314%25%20Off.%204.%20%281.8K%29%20Ghar%20Soaps.)
* **Why it’s great:** Perfect if your oily skin is also sensitive or prone to irritation.[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/skin/cleansers/face-wash/c/8379#:~:text=%28217.9K%29%20Simple.%20Refreshing%20Facial%20Wash%2C%20100%25%20Soap-Free,Acne.%202%20Sizes.%20Oily%20Skin.%20%E2%82%B9299%E2%82%B926910%25%20Off.) While the salicylic acid targets sebum and prevents breakouts, Cica (Centella Asiatica) instantly soothes inflammation and redness.[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/skin/cleansers/face-wash/c/8379#:~:text=%28217.9K%29%20Simple.%20Refreshing%20Facial%20Wash%2C%20100%25%20Soap-Free,Acne.%202%20Sizes.%20Oily%20Skin.%20%E2%82%B9299%E2%82%B926910%25%20Off.)
